explanation: I grepped Mathlib for map_smulₛₗ₂ and map_smul₂. The only other declarations with these names are ContinuousLinearMap.map_smulₛₗ₂ and ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul₂. They are about continuous linear maps, a different type, so they don't give a duplicate. LinearMap.map_smul₂ at line 220 of the same file is the special case with ρ₁₂ = id, which is weaker than the target. The target's own proof applies the generic map_smulₛₗ to `flip f y`. That is a general homomorphism law, so it doesn't count as a duplicate. I found no separate declaration for the bilinear statement `f (r • x) y = ρ₁₂ r • f x y`.
